items.title: Joe Loyacano Interview, 1959-08-20
items.q: Arnold played a little piano, bass, drum. Guitar, mandolin.

ctx.x: And what instruments did they play?

items.title: Arnold Loyacano Interview, 1956-09-29
items.q: And Joe and Jack would get out their horns and I'd get the bass fiddle and we'd play along with the old-fashioned piano.

ctx.x: Uh-huh. He was husky. Well, before you actually got good enough to play with those kids' bands, did you all just play in the neighborhood? Did you have a little band that would make up in the

neighborhood? Well, I tell you, we had an old-fashioned player piano. And we used to get my nephew to pump it. Well, she had a pump it pedal, do you remember that? Yeah. And Joe and Jack would get out their horns and I'd get the bass fiddle and we'd play along with the old-fashioned piano. My nephew would paddlet.
